whatMakesDifferent.question: What is sparkrobin.app?
whatMakesDifferent.answer: sparkrobin.app is an independent Spark Robin release-watch and AI video workflow site. It helps creators track confirmed updates, structure reusable prompts, and create practical video drafts from text or images.

characterConsistency.question: Is Spark Robin officially available from Google?
characterConsistency.answer: Google has not confirmed a public Spark Robin release in the materials we reference. Treat specific model specs as watch items until they appear in official Google, Google DeepMind, or Google Cloud documentation.

videosLongerThan10s.question: What can I do here before official access arrives?
videosLongerThan10s.answer: You can prepare prompts, references, shot lists, and draft clips now. That makes it easier to move quickly when new model access or official Spark Robin details become available.

commercialUse.question: Can I use the drafts commercially?
commercialUse.answer: Commercial use depends on the plan, your source assets, your prompts, and the terms that apply to the generation workflow. Review licensing and asset rights before publishing.

watermarks.question: Why focus on prompt systems instead of only generation?
watermarks.answer: AI video changes quickly. A structured prompt system gives your team reusable creative direction that can move across tools, models, and future Spark Robin updates.

paymentSafe.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentSafe.answer: We accept the payment methods shown at checkout through secure payment providers. Pricing is shown before purchase so you can review the plan and billing terms before you pay.

hiddenCharges.question: Are there any hidden charges?
hiddenCharges.answer: No. The displayed price is the amount you pay for the selected plan. There are no hidden charges added later outside the stated billing terms.

faqCancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqCancelAnytime.answer: Yes! All plans can be canceled anytime. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period.

faqCreditsRollOver.question: Do unused credits roll over?
faqCreditsRollOver.answer: Subscription bucket resets each billing period and does not roll over. One-time add-on credits go to the flexible bucket and are not cleared by subscription resets.

faqRefundPolicy.question: What is sparkrobin.app refund policy?
faqRefundPolicy.answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for all subscription plans. Contact support@sparkrobin.app for refunds. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

faqContentRestrictions.question: Are there any video content restrictions?
faqContentRestrictions.answer: Our platform enforces strict content policies. We prohibit the generation of harmful, illegal, or inappropriate content. All generated videos undergo automatic screening to ensure policy compliance.

faqCreditsDeduction.question: Will credits be deducted if generation fails?
faqCreditsDeduction.answer: No. Credits are deducted atomically when a job starts, and automatically refunded if the generation fails or the upstream service returns an error. Refunds usually appear within a minute.

faqCancelSubscription.question: What happens to credits if I cancel my subscription?
faqCancelSubscription.answer: You can cancel anytime. Flexible (one-time) credits remain available. Subscription bucket follows your billing period and stops refreshing after the current period ends.

whatIsTool.question: What is the Image to Video tool?
whatIsTool.answer: Our AI Image to Video tool transforms your static images into fully animated videos using advanced AI. Simply upload your photo, illustration, or product image, and the AI brings it to life with natural motion, camera movements, and synchronized audio.

needExperience.question: Do I need any animation or video editing experience to use the Image to Video tool?
needExperience.answer: No experience is needed. Simply upload your image file, and the AI will automatically generate a high-quality animated video with natural motion and professional effects - no technical skills required.

imageTypes.question: What types of images work best with the Image to Video tool?
imageTypes.answer: The tool works with a wide variety of images including product photos, portraits, landscapes, illustrations, architectural photos, and design mockups. The AI analyzes the composition and generates motion that makes sense contextually for each image type.

howLong.question: How long does it take to generate a video from an image?
howLong.answer: Timing depends on model availability, queue state, and draft complexity. The important part is keeping the prompt, reference image, and review notes together so each next pass improves faster.

motionType.question: What kind of motion does the AI add to images?
motionType.answer: Describe the motion you want explicitly: camera push-in, orbit, product turn, subtle portrait movement, background change, lighting shift, or pacing notes. Specific motion language is easier to evaluate than vague cinematic requests.

commercialUse.question: Can I use Image to Video generated videos for commercial purposes?
commercialUse.answer: Prompt systems and draft workflows can support commercial planning. Final usage depends on the generation model, source assets, likeness rights, music, and platform terms, so review those before publishing.
